instruction.text: What do these objects have in common?

hint.text: The objects in the image  are a newspaper, a laptop, a book, a radio and a mobile phone.

b: They are all the same size.

atoms.b: You’ve probably heard of media before. Media is an ((++important)) part of our everyday life. We use ((++different)) forms of media to exchange information, to ((++communicate)), to educate ourselves and for ((++entertainment)).

instruction.text: Select the object that can be used for communication, education or entertainment.

feedback.end: Using a smartphone, we can not only communicate through calls and texts, but also access the internet, listen to music and much more.
Like smartphones, laptops can be used for many different forms of communication, learning and entertainment.
Newspapers have been a way of sharing information for hundreds of years.
Radios are used to listen to music or talk shows from different radio stations.
